purpose: One absolutely-positioned decorative leaf in a leaf layer.
geometry: position absolute; width/height from LEAF_ART; z-index from the coordinate row (default 1); --leaf-rotate custom property; transform = translateX/Y (em for drift, % of own box for scroll) then rotate

states.note: No interactive state exists. A generator must not add one.

classNames.marketing-responsive-leaf: has a phone-specific top, switched by a CSS custom property at <=479px
classNames.(no class): QUOTE_LEAVES and the /our-purpose wreath — STATIC, initial === animate

accessibility: always alt='' aria-hidden='true', inside a pointer-events-none span
